paper.title_en: feedback-grape: A JAX-based Python Package for GPU-Accelerated GRAPE with Feedback
paper.abstract_en: Modern quantum technology applications require accurate control of quantum systems, including a feedback loop in the control process. While open-loop control can be performed using well established gradient methods like GRadient Ascent Pulse Engineering (GRAPE), it was until recently unclear how to combine these with feedback from measurements, which are inherently non-differentiable. Recent work has successfully demonstrated how feedback can be incorporated into GRAPE using machine learning, resolving this issue. Following this progress, we have developed an efficient Python package implementing the method of ``feedback GRAPE''. In this hands-on tutorial, we discuss the package in detail based on concrete examples. Built on the GPU-accelerated JAX platform, our package offers a user-friendly interface inspired by the widely-used QuTiP library, including simplified treatment of multi-component systems.
